summary.intent: Fix a failing vault recovery E2E test in CI, then handle several follow-on issues discovered during deployment: Grafana provisioning failures, missing Tauri signing key wiring, outdated codebase docs, and writable shares E2E failures.
summary.outcome: All five issues were resolved: vault recovery E2E fixed (PR #369), Grafana API key identified as expired, Tauri signing keys wired into staging workflow (PR #370), codebase docs fully rewritten for multi-package architecture, and writable shares E2E fixed locally and in CI (PR #376), plus desktop build workflow consolidated into staging (PR #379).

repo: IPNS records use protobuf field 1 for the CID value ('value') and field 2 for signatureV1 — recovery.html had these reversed in extractCidFromIpnsRecord
resolveIpns tried the slow IPFS gateway HEAD first (15s timeout) before delegated routing; order should be swapped for CI compatibility with mock-ipns-routing
Standalone file shares create a synthetic FilePointer with id=shareId, but share_keys stores file-ipns keys with itemId=fileId — a UUID mismatch that silently breaks write operations
ThrottlerModule in app.module.ts uses hardcoded limits; NODE_ENV=test does not bypass throttling by default — limits must be made config-aware explicitly
TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY and TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD were in GitHub repo secrets but not passed as env vars to any tauri-action steps in deploy-staging.yml
tauri-apps/tauri-action@v1 does not exist; the latest major version tag is @v0 (currently v0.6.2)
Grafana Cloud returns HTTP 404 (not 401/403) when a Bearer token is invalid or expired — health endpoint behavior differs from REST API endpoints
Staging releases were marked prerelease: true, which prevents /releases/latest/ from resolving — breaks Tauri auto-updater which uses that URL for latest.json
includeUpdaterJson was never passed to tauri-action in deploy-staging.yml, so latest.json was never generated for the auto-updater
The create-desktop-release job created the GitHub release with --prerelease while tauri-action steps set prerelease: false — inconsistent state

code.finding: Vault key blob fetch tried direct IPFS gateway /ipns/ path first with 30s timeout before delegated routing fallback — inverted order caused 30s hang in CI where Kubo can't resolve mock-published IPNS names
extractCidFromIpnsRecord checked fieldNumber === 2 (signatureV1) instead of fieldNumber === 1 (value) when parsing protobuf IPNS records from delegated routing responses
Backoff retry only triggered on thrown errors, not on non-OK HTTP responses (429/5xx) — needed explicit !resp.ok check before retry sleep

getFileIpnsKeyFn for standalone file shares searched for keys by itemId using the shareId, but keys were stored with the actual fileId — fallback added for itemType === 'file' shares to use first available file-ipns key
ThrottlerModule used hardcoded limits (100/min); converted to forRootAsync to read NODE_ENV and apply 200/sec + 2000/min limits in test mode

Stale closure race: textarea.fill() triggers React onChange async but keyboard.press fires immediately after — isDirty was still false so Ctrl+S handler skipped save; fix was to wait for 'modified' status indicator before sending keypress
Three tauri-action invocations (macOS/Windows/Linux) were all missing TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY and TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD env vars despite secrets existing in the repo

workflow: Run web-e2e tests locally before committing to avoid CI round-trip cycles — requires services running with NODE_ENV=test to disable throttle limits
Grafana Cloud service account tokens (for dashboard CRUD via HTTP API) are separate from Grafana Loki/Prometheus API keys (for data source push) — they live under Administration > Service Accounts
GitHub Actions /releases/latest/ resolves only to non-prerelease releases; prerelease: true on staging builds breaks any tooling that uses that URL
Parallel agent spawning for codebase documentation rewrites is effective — 3 agents covering 6 of 7 files completed in ~7 minutes with minimal orchestrator context usage
When web E2E tests fail with different errors locally vs CI, check NODE_ENV first — throttle differences cause cascading failures that mask the real root cause

friction: Multiple CI round-trips (3+ PRs) before getting writable-shares E2E passing — root cause was not reproducible locally until NODE_ENV=test throttle fix was applied
1Password SSH agent inaccessible from subprocesses, blocking git commit signing in background bash tasks
Docker Hub authentication failures (transient GitHub Actions infrastructure issue) caused spurious CI failures on PR #377
Stale git index.lock left by a crashed process required manual removal before git operations could resume
Parallel writable-shares test runs (background full suite + isolation run) interfered with each other via shared database/API state, producing misleading results
tauri-apps/tauri-action@v1 doesn't exist but was referenced in build-desktop.yml — caused startup_failure with no actionable error message from GitHub
open_items: docs/milestone-v1.1-completion branch has codebase doc updates committed but not yet PR'd or merged
Milestone v1.1 completion workflow (/gsd:complete-milestone) still pending — all 12 phases done but milestone not archived

Full web-e2e suite has 3 locally-failing tests (recycle-bin TC01, mfa-flows TC-MFA-01, full-workflow 6.5.4) that pass in CI — not investigated, likely local environment differences with Web3Auth MFA infra and IPFS node behavior

Tauri auto-updater endpoint in tauri.conf.json points to /releases/latest/download/latest.json — needs verification that latest.json is actually uploaded and accessible after first non-prerelease staging build
